actions.name: screenshot
actions.title: Screenshot
actions.summary: the KVM's picture of the screen (JPEG); later coordinates are in its pixels

actions.name: left_click
actions.title: Left click
actions.summary: left click at a point in the last screenshot

actions.name: right_click
actions.title: Right click
actions.summary: right click at a point in the last screenshot

actions.name: double_click
actions.title: Double click
actions.summary: double click at a point in the last screenshot

actions.name: type
actions.title: Type
actions.summary: type text (never a password: the sitter types that itself)

actions.name: key
actions.title: Key
actions.summary: press a key or combo: cmd+space, Return, ctrl+shift+4

actions.name: unlock
actions.title: Unlock
actions.summary: ask the sitter to type its sealed copy of the password, only if its own fresh look reads the prompt

actions.name: power_cycle
actions.title: Power cycle
actions.summary: smart plug off, then on by itself (one per 30 min, three a day)
